column1: # Version comparison vectors: A, B and the result of vercmp A B.
# The test also checks vercmp B A, which must give the opposite result.
# The first block is the list in pacman's test/util/vercmptest.sh.
# Columns are separated by one tab.
# same or similar content, different separators
# epoch, and a pkgrel on one side only
# More vectors, each worked through the algorithm in version.c.
# a longer version is newer when the shared part is equal
# an epoch is stronger than any version
# a number longer than any integer type
# a numeric segment is newer than an alpha segment
# ~ is a separator for pacman, not an "older than" mark
# letters compare in ASCII order: upper case before lower case
